data.gender_notes: Abbasiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abbasiyah is a name that signifies a connection to the Abbasid dynasty, a prominent Islamic caliphate. It is a name that evokes a sense of heritage and nobility. The name Abbasiyah carries the meaning “Descendant of Abbas” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abbasiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody descendant of abbas and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Abbasiyah is associated with the virtues of generosity and hospitality, as embodied by Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, the uncle of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
data.etymology: Abbasiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Descendant of Abbas.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abbasiyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
